fusions.name: Caught in Irons
fusions.desc: Throws a set of shackles at a target up to 7 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Boarding Net Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted net over a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 8 damage to everything in it with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Batten the Gratings
fusions.desc: After a 1-second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Galley Draft
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
